protocol_amendment_1.reason: The executor incorrectly treated the benign hard-negative truth label as the detector precondition, although the fixture is a declared BEH-001 false positive.
protocol_amendment_1.change: Keep expected_rule_ids=[] as ground truth and add detector_expected_rule_ids=[BEH-001] solely for the detector precondition.
protocol_amendment_1.reuse_justification: The amendment changes no telemetry, prompt, model parameter, response validator, adversarial value, sanitized value, or paired metric; the 12 already preserved responses remain protocol-identical and are reused.
protocol_amendment_1.analysis_boundary: This post-start implementation correction is disclosed and the adversarial experiment is not described as strictly preregistered without amendment.

claim_boundary: One paired call per model/category estimates observed decision influence only; it does not estimate attack success probability or stability.
